moments.title: Halloween Weekend Approaching

moments.title: Bonfire Night Next Week
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night, or Bonfire Night, is celebrated across the UK on Thursday, November 5th, with fireworks and bonfires often extending into the following weekend.

angles.name: Remember, Remember

angles.name: Fireworks Safety

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born singer Jamie Miller, 29, has achieved his first UK number one single with 'Babydoll', marking the first Welsh artist to top the charts in 15 years.

angles.name: Welsh Chart Topper
angles.copy: HUGE NEWS for Wales! Cardiff's own Jamie Miller has hit #1 on the UK Singles Chart with 'Babydoll'! The first Welsh artist in 15 years to do it. Get in!

angles.name: New Number One
angles.copy: Congratulations to Jamie Miller on his debut UK #1 single 'Babydoll'! Tune in to hear the chart-topping track.
